module.label: Voice & microphone
module.description: One capture and decoder owner for all voice commands.

flows.label: A voice trigger
flows.detail: One microphone/model owner and exclusive session. Trigger once to start; trigger again while listening finishes early. Saved timeout measures a quiet pause after confirmed speech, not recording length. One session watchdog ends capture after that pause or the five-second absolute safety limit; no speech or failed detection is discarded without inference and empty completion releases feature state. Normal triggers rearm one second after completion; processing presses and stale session/revision intents cannot reopen capture. The cached bundled Silero detector runs only on active audio in the existing drain worker with two seconds of bounded context and native-rate normalization warmed before readiness. Stored PCM cannot exceed five seconds. Editor uploads share the exclusive inference lease and preserve optional word timing and cleanup.

steps.label: Microphone available?
steps.detail: Another consumer or model startup can reject the trigger.

steps.label: Listen for this module
steps.detail: Measure speech on the existing drain worker. Finish after the saved quiet pause, explicit Finish, or the five-second cap. No-speech and detector-failure deadlines release capture without inference.

steps.label: Transcribe once
steps.detail: One inference lease. Original capture-start timestamp is preserved for replay cutoffs; no speech sends only empty completion.

steps.label: Deliver to the same session
steps.detail: Cancellation, replacement, and old trigger/watchdog/UI session IDs reject stale work. A one-second normal-trigger rearm guard prevents an immediate restart after automatic completion.
